templateGuide.title: Tag-Based Parsing: Format Guide
templateGuide.description: Separate standalone questions with {question}; use {stimulus} and {group} for material-based question groups. Both full-width {fullwidth} and half-width {halfwidth} forms are recognized.

notes.question: Starts each question and separates questions from each other
notes.stimulus: Declares multi-line question material; the name is optional and used when reusing the material
notes.group: Starts a question group; without a name, it uses the most recently declared material
notes.groupEnd: Ends the question group so following questions are standalone again; a new group, material, or section heading also ends the current group
notes.options: As a block {block} or one by one {perItem}
notes.answer: Letters for choice questions (multiple answers like {multiExample}); {trueFalse} for true/false
notes.answerSection: Aliases: {aliases}; for an answer key at the end of the document
